correctness.rationale: For all m,n>=1 the exact coefficient ranges follow direct count. With minimum one all coefficients are negative; otherwise c1>0 and ordered coefficients have exactly one positive-to-negative sign change, so Descartes' sign rule bounds positive derivative roots by one. Prefix-cut identity proves derivative at rho=1 negative while c1 gives derivative at 0 positive; unique simple interior maximum. Gaussian tails strictly increase in variance for every positive threshold. Exact independent checker verifies coefficient and cut formulas across 400 length pairs; finite checks are diagnostics only.

value.rationale: A complete sharp classification of autocorrelation-induced ramp amplification for arbitrary unequal positive integer reporting periods, with a natural singleton boundary, resolves a physically motivated temporal-aggregation design question. For lengths 2 vs 10, fixed-marginal persistence can raise contrast variance 48.29% and modeled exceedance from 0.1967 to 0.2891. The theorem is not merely an arbitrary small numerical slice or rediscovery of the equal-width formula; its all-length phase boundary is the reusable structural feature.
